item.title: Wrongful Death Lawsuit Filed In 2024 Log Truck, Propane Truck Crash That Killed Molino Girl
item.description: One year after 12-year-old Sofia Bennett of Molino died in a multi-vehicle crash in Pace, a wrongful death lawsuit has been filed against several companies involved in the wreck. item.title: Overturned Dump Trucks Spills Hot Asphalt, Shuts Down Miles Of Highway 29
item.description: An overturned dump truck hauling hot asphalt closed nearly seven miles of northbound Highway 29 for hours on Friday. The driver of the Roads, Inc. dump truck lost control on Highway 29 northbound, left the roadway, overcorrected, and overturned just over a mile south of Bogia Road in McDavid. item.title: Pickup Truck Reported Stolen 19 Years Ago Found In North Escambia Lake
item.description: The Escambia County Sheriff’s Office dive team has recovered a pickup truck from a local lake that was reported stolen 19 years ago. According to Sheriff Chip Simmons, a fisherman on Cotton Lake, north of Molino, spotted what he believed was a vehicle in the water. item.title: CIC To Host Christmas In The Park Today In Cantonment
item.description: The Cantonment Improvement Committee will host Christmas In The Park on Saturday at 3 p.m. in Carver Park, 208 Webb Street. The event will include free toys, hot chocolate, the Grinch, and a possible special visit from Santa Claus, according to organizers. All school-age children are welcome to attend for a fun time.
